game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort, a fort on the sea cliffs: the fisher must handle rogue waves while practicing conditionals (if / elif / else). Core idea – Discount Rules: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount.
theme: Coastal Port – Cliffside Fort: a fort on the sea cliffs
core_gameplay_loop: In Cliffside Fort, repeat each round: Apply shop rules like if total >= 100 to give each customer the right discount. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the profit value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about profit to power up the fisher and open the sea wall.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 3 – Conditionals (if / elif / else) | Level 4 (applied tier): Discount Rules
assets_style: pixel-art harbor town: deep blue sea, wooden docks, orange-roofed buildings, sailing ships; flat Kenney-style sprites; sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Discount Rules' (Week 3 slot 10), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Cliffside Fort'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Coastal Port
region.mood: sea-shanty accordion with wave and gull ambience

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how profit changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rogue waves in Cliffside Fort.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
